The '''Class-7 Repair Vessel''' were used for supplying, repairing and defending [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colonies.

==Characteristics==
The Class-7 were 560 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and were armed with a turreted [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery. It also had a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
